concerns.text: The plan cites the dataset **CodedotAI/code_clippy_github** (https://huggingface.co/datasets/CodedotAI/code_clippy_github) as the source of open‑access images for visual salience manipulation. This dataset contains code snippets, not visual images, making it inappropriate for a study that requires morally ambiguous visual stimuli. Using this dataset cannot satisfy the research question about visual salience effects on moral judgments.
